claims.evidence: The report shows a used engine but no visible displacement badge, quality grade, or sensor identification; brand and model are unreadable.

risks.risk: Engine may not run or start
risks.proof: Video of the engine starting and running
Odometer photo, service records, or VIN-based age check
risks.if_unproven: priced as unknown age and high mileage

risks.risk: Unknown vehicle make and model fitment
risks.proof: VIN plate photo or engine block casting numbers

risks.risk: No service history or previous repairs

risks.proof: Compression test results or bench test report
risks.if_unproven: priced as untested with possible internal damage

risks.risk: Missing components such as ECU, sensors, or gearbox
risks.proof: Itemized video showing all included parts

risks.risk: Internal damage not visible in photos
risks.proof: Borescope inspection video or teardown report
risks.if_unproven: priced as risk of internal damage

risks.risk: No seller warranty or return policy
risks.proof: Written warranty terms or return policy screenshot
risks.if_unproven: priced as as-is with no warranty

proof_requests: Video of the engine starting and running
Photo of the VIN plate or engine block casting numbers
Compression test results or bench test report
Itemized video showing all included components such as ECU and sensors
response.reason: The witness identifies a used car engine, so it can be valued at its worst case despite unproven claims and hidden risks; proof can raise the value later.
